description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kadurugaswewa, Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District  - Cad. Map No. 120081
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their registration details, ownership status (primarily "The State"), and land parcel particulars. The document is explicitly labeled "PART III - LANDS" and focuses on land title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
